Introduce the idea of having Net friends.
Explain that through the Internet it is possible
to use instant messaging. It is quicker than e-
mailing friends. You type a short note and you
send it to another person’s computer, where
it pops up on the screen. So, you can “chat”
with a friend if he/ she is online too, even if
both of you are using the computer for other
tasks. And, of course, you don’t have to check
your e-mail inbox for new messages.
Another thing is that in this instant
people can take part, so a group of people
can be online exchanging responses at the
same time. You can exchange photos and if
you have microphones or speakers you can
talk, too. Finally, using web cameras you
